name: MongoDB
description: The MongoDB app is a unified logs and metrics app that helps you monitor the availability, performance, health and resource utilization of your MongoDB database clusters. Preconfigured dashboards provide insight into cluster status, logins, connections, slow queries, replication, resource utilization, sharding, errors and warnings.

queries.queryString:

children.name: MongoDB - Query Logs
children.description: This dashboard shows MongoDB slow queries with connection ID, queries by keysExamined value, and queries with KeysExamined Greater than nreturned
children.title: MongoDB - Query Logs

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/MongoDB db_cluster={{db_cluster}} _sourceHost={{host}} db_system=mongodb | json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as _raw 
| json field=_raw "t.$date" as timestamp
| json field=_raw "s" as severity
| json field=_raw "c" as component
| json field=_raw "ctx" as context
| json field=_raw "msg" as msg
| where component matches "*COMMAND*"
| json field=_raw "attr.type" as type
| where type matches "*command*"
| json field=_raw "attr.command" as command
| replace (command,"{","") as command
| replace (command,"}","") as command
| parse regex field=command "(?<db_cmd>[\w\-\.]+):*"
| where db_cmd matches "*find*" or db_cmd matches "*insert*" or db_cmd matches "*remove*" or db_cmd matches "*delete*" or db_cmd matches "*update*"
| json field=_raw "attr.durationMillis" as dur
| number(dur)
| where dur > 100
| count

_sourceCategory = Labs/MongoDB db_cluster={{db_cluster}} db_system=mongodb | json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as _raw 
| json field=_raw "t.$date" as timestamp
| json field=_raw "s" as severity
| json field=_raw "c" as component
| json field=_raw "ctx" as context
| json field=_raw "msg" as msg
| where component matches "*COMMAND*" and ( msg matches "*Waiting for connections*" or msg matches "*transition to*" or msg matches "*Now exiting*")
| if (msg matches "*Now exiting*", "Down",if (msg matches "*transition to*", "Up" ,if (msg matches "*Waiting for connections*", "Up", "UnKnown")))  as server_status
| where server_status = "Up"
| _sourceHost as Host
| timeslice 100s
| withtime server_status | withtime _messagetime
| most_recent(server_status_withtime) as server_status, most_recent(_messagetime_withtime) as m_time by Host
| formatDate(fromMillis(m_time), "MM-dd-yyyy HH:mm:ss:SSS", "UTC") as event_time
| ((toMillis(now())-m_time)/(1000*60)) as since_mins | format("%.2f", since_mins) as since_minutes
| concat ("Since ", since_minutes, " minutes") as Remark
| fields - m_time, since_mins, since_minutes 
| fields Host, event_time, server_status, remark

_sourceCategory = Labs/MongoDB db_cluster={{db_cluster}} db_system=mongodb | json "log" as _rawlog nodrop

| json field=_raw "s" as severity

| if (msg matches "*Now exiting*", "Down",if (msg matches "*transition to*", "Up" ,if (msg matches "*Waiting for connections*", "Up", "UnKnown")))  as server_status 
| where !(server_status = "Up")
| _sourceHost as Host
| timeslice 100s
| withtime server_status | withtime _messagetime

| formatDate(fromMillis(m_time), "MM-dd-yyyy HH:mm:ss:SSS", "UTC") as event_time
| ((toMillis(now())-m_time)/(1000*60)) as since_mins | format("%.2f", since_mins) as since_minutes
| concat ("Since ", since_minutes, " minutes") as Remark
| fields - m_time, since_mins, since_minutes 
| fields Host, event_time, server_status, remark
